repository: repository — a named space for content with its own access rules and storage policy
artifact: artifact — one immutable stored file with its SHA-256; new content makes a new artifact
upload: upload — the act of sending a file to the server; also the upload session that reserves it
uploadSession: upload session — a reservation for one file, completed once every byte has arrived
part: part — one piece of a large file sent separately (multipart upload)
resume: resume — to continue an interrupted upload or download from where it stopped
package: package — a versioned UPack package (group, name, SemVer version)
packageGroup: package group — the first part of a package's name (UPack group)
version: version — a SemVer version of a package (1.4.2)
versionRange: version range — a set of versions, such as ^1.4
build: build — the output of one CI run, stored as an artifact or a package version
label: label — a short tag on an artifact (nightly, tested)
metadata: metadata — key/value text fields of an artifact
collection: collection — a named set of artifacts
attachment: attachment — a file attached to a build: a manifest, an SBOM, a signature, a report
fileByPath: file by path — a file addressed by a path in the repository (builds/game/Setup.exe) that keeps its earlier versions
revision: revision — a numbered version of a file by path, of metadata or of a setting
history: history — the earlier revisions of a file or of a set
restore: restore — to make an earlier revision current again; also to recover data from a backup
stage: stage — a mark on a build such as qa, release or prod
promotion: promotion — publishing a build in another repository without uploading it again
move: move — a promotion that also removes the build from the source repository
resolve: resolve — to find the build a stage and a version range point to
mirror: mirror — a read-only copy of a repository kept by a second installation
mirrorSource: source (of a mirror) — the installation a mirror copies from
failover: failover — an operator promoting a mirror to take over when the source is lost (nothing happens automatically)
readGateway: read gateway — an extra download-only server process on the same storage
backup: backup — a scheduled copy of the database and the content
backupAgent: backup agent — the service that makes and verifies backups
vault: vault — the backup storage: a folder on another disk or a network share
restorePoint: restore point — one complete backup that can be restored
pin: pin — to keep something from automatic deletion (a restore point, a build)
retention: retention — the rules for how long content or backups are kept
retentionPolicy: retention policy — the saved retention rules of a repository
quota: quota — the most space a repository may use
cleanup: cleanup (physical cleanup) — freeing disk space of deleted content in the background
gracePeriod: grace period — the time deleted content stays on disk before cleanup
account: account — a person's sign-in on the server
owner: owner — the first account, an administrator with write access to the first repository; it cannot manage service accounts or use service-key-only actions
administrator: administrator — an account that manages the server
group: group — a set of accounts that share permissions
permission: permission — the right to do one action (read, write, delete…)
serviceAccount: service account — an account for CI or automation, used through keys
serviceKey: service key — the secret a service account signs in with
personalAccessToken: personal access token — a person's secret for scripts and the command line
policy: policy — the saved rules of a service account or of a repository
delegation: delegation — handing part of the administration of service accounts to someone
rotate: rotate — to replace a key with a new one while the old one still works
revoke: revoke — to cancel a key or a token for good
recoveryKey: recovery key (bootstrap key) — the installation's secret for creating the owner and recovering access
onboarding: onboarding — the first steps after installation in the console
update: update — a newer stable release of Arkvory, and installing it
stableRelease: stable release — a release that ProAnimaStudio has approved
maintenanceHour: maintenance hour — the hour (UTC) in which automatic updates may install
rollback: roll back — to return to the previous version after an update
hub: hub — the ProAnimaStudio service that announces updates and receives feedback
catalog: catalog — the list of artifacts in a repository
downloadLink: download link — a time-limited link to one artifact for someone without a key
requestId: request ID — the identifier of one request, for support
idempotencyKey: idempotency key — a value that makes a repeated request have the same effect once
checksum: checksum — the SHA-256 that proves the bytes are the expected ones
registry: registry — a server that clients such as Docker or npm push to and pull from
tag: tag — a container image's name for a version (latest, 1.4)
digest: digest — a container image's content address (sha256:…)
lock: lock — a Git LFS file lock
worker: worker — the service that finishes large uploads and synchronizes mirrors
selfHealing: self-healing — the services restarting by themselves after a crash or a hang
installationRoot: installation root — the folder with the data, configuration and logs
feedback: feedback — a report with screenshots and logs sent to ProAnimaStudio
